subject: iq-ai-2025-01
candidate: LiquidityManager.moveLiquidity / addLiquidityToFraxswap (M-01 — attacker pre-creates Fraxswap pair)

defenses.evidence: moveLiquidity is external with no auth; anyone can trigger migration
createPair is permissionless on the Fraxswap factory; an attacker can pre-create the (currency, agent) pair
addLiquidityToFraxswap uses getPair() and ADOPTS any existing pair; no check that the pair was protocol-created
the else-branch (pair exists) never verifies the existing pair's fee == intended manager.fee(); only the create-branch sets the intended fee
price comes from bootstrapPool.getPrice() only; no external price sanity
the 3-round getMaxSell swaps + final mint have no minimum-output checks
Fraxswap MINIMUM_LIQUIDITY exists but does not prevent fee/price manipulation
not relevant to this vector; not present on moveLiquidity
post-move fee-balance asserts exist in the project test but do not bound the adopted pool's fee/price
no check that the migrated pool's fee/price match protocol intent

coverage_summary: DOES_NOT_COVER dominates; no guard prevents adopting an attacker-pre-created pair with a low fee.
minimal_mitigation: In the pair-exists branch, require((10_000 - fraxswapPair.fee()) == fee) (or restrict pair creation / verify protocol-created). Validated: blocks the attacker pair, clean migration still succeeds.
